description: FHIR R4 Location resource — details and position information for a physical place where services are provided and resources and participants may be stored, found, contained, or accommodated.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: Unique code or number identifying the location to its users.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: The status property covers the general availability of the resource, not the current value which may be covered by the operationStatus, or by a schedule/slots if they are configured for the location. Values: active | suspended | inactive.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the location as used by humans. Does not need to be unique.

fields.label: Alias
fields.description: A list of alternate names that the location is known as, or was known as, in the past.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Description of the Location, which helps in finding or referencing the place.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Indicates whether a resource instance represents a specific location or a class of locations. Values: instance | kind.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Indicates the type of function performed at the location. e.g. HOSP (hospital), EMER (emergency), LAB (laboratory room).

fields.label: Telecom
fields.description: The contact details of communication devices available at the location. This can include phone numbers, fax numbers, mobile numbers, email addresses and web sites.

fields.label: Physical Type
fields.description: Physical form of the location, e.g. building, room, vehicle, road. Values: bu (building), wi (wing), wa (ward), lvl (level), ro (room), bd (bed), ve (vehicle).

fields.label: Managing Organization
fields.description: The organization responsible for the provisioning and upkeep of the location.

fields.label: Part Of
fields.description: Another Location of which this Location is physically a part of.

fields.label: Hours Of Operation
fields.description: What days/times during a week is this location usually open.
